- **Android Internals & OS Engineering**: Kernel compiling, bootloader unlocking workflows, Generic System Images (GSI) flashing, system-as-root partition mapping (system, vendor, product, odm), ADB/Fastboot automation, custom ROM deployment, Magisk/KernelSU modules, low-level system tweaking.
- **Full-Stack Web & Tooling**: TypeScript, Next.js (App Router), React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, Three.js / WebGL shaders, Web Audio API, Framer Motion, Lenis smooth physics.
- **Reverse Engineering & Automation**: PowerShell automation, Linux bash scripting, workflow automation, AI integration, markdown tooling.
- **Core Philosophy**: "Breaking systems, understanding them fundamentally, and rebuilding better versions."

## Shipped Systems & Open-Source Projects (10 Repositories)
1. **MKR Music**: Flagship universal Android audiophile streaming application with synthesized Web Audio FX, offline caching, and responsive high-fidelity UI. (Tech: React Native, TypeScript, Web Audio API, Android NDK).
2. **Revision Master**: Automated syllabus pacing & smart study scheduling engine for high-retention learning workflows. (Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, LocalStorage DB, Tailwind CSS).
3. **Android Cheatsheet**: Comprehensive deep-dive reference manual for fastboot commands, partition tables, EDL recovery, and kernel debugging. (Tech: Markdown, GitBook, Bash, Documentation Engine).
4. **CalcVerse**: Next-generation scientific calculation suite featuring custom matrix transformations and formula history. (Tech: TypeScript, Math.js, Tailwind CSS).
5. **ReadmeHub**: Live GitHub profile README generator and dual-mode real-time Markdown studio with shield badge builder. (Tech: React, Remark/Rehype, Markdown AST, Canvas).
6. **Tailor System**: Bespoke bespoke garment dimension ledger and dynamic measurement calculation suite. (Tech: TypeScript, Next.js, Responsive Canvas).
7. **Matrix Calculator**: Interactive linear algebra computational tool featuring row-echelon reduction, determinant expansion, and eigenvalue calculation. (Tech: TypeScript, Canvas API, WebAssembly).
8. **Bootloader Unlock Guide & Scripts**: Multi-OEM automated bootloader unlock toolchain and step-by-step diagnostic guide for Qualcomm and MediaTek devices. (Tech: Python, ADB/Fastboot, Shell Scripting).
9. **GSI Flashing Guide**: Production-tested guide and companion utility scripts for deploying Android Generic System Images across Treble-compliant architectures. (Tech: Android Treble, FastbootD, Dynamic Partitions).
10. **Windows Activation & Optimization Suite**: Clean PowerShell system optimization scripts for telemetry removal, bloatware cleanup, and automated licensing diagnostics. (Tech: PowerShell, Windows Registry, Batch).
